findings.title: The MS-4.1 copy check skips the FAQ answers and every sentence with a {value}
findings.fix: Also collect the plain-text answer after each bold FAQ question; for strings with {…}, split on /\{[^}]+\}/ and require every literal fragment of 8+ characters to appear in the rendered text; check the model line only when modelRuns is not null.

findings.title: The tablet bar layout needs a visual reorder, which breaks MS-13.2 focus order
findings.where: design.md §0 (Tablet 720-1023px: row 1 brand and CTA, row 2 the nav); MS-13.2; site.mjs Tab-order check only at 1280
findings.fix: State that the bar never reorders its children (no order or grid placement that differs from DOM order brand, nav, CTA); they wrap in DOM order at 720-1023px (up to 208px); update the 744x1047 fold estimate; run the bar Tab-order check at 820x1094 too. Alternatively change the DOM order everywhere and write that down.

findings.title: Short links are narrower than 56px, and the footer nav has no row gap (MS-10.4)
findings.where: design.md §0 nav links, §12 footer ('As today's /welcome footer', gap 0 20px); MS-10.4; site.mjs size check
findings.fix: Standalone links (bar nav, footer nav, .site-links a) get inline-flex, centred, min-height and min-width var(--target-min); link groups use gap var(--space-2) var(--space-6); write the footer rules out on tokens; site.mjs checks width and an 8px gap within each group.

findings.title: The MS-8.1 selector check would fail on globals.css
findings.fix: Scope 'every animation selector starts with [data-site-motion' to site.css; in globals.css allow only the A6 view-transition rules inside no-preference and the existing reduce guard.

findings.title: The proof frame 3 label must be 16px, not 14px
findings.where: design.md Drawings (frame labels 14px or more); §3; MS-10.5; site.mjs text-size check
findings.fix: Frame labels use the label size (16px), or frame 3's label element is aria-hidden; say which.

findings.title: The tablet hero padding is not given
findings.fix: Tablet (600-1023px) hero padding block var(--space-12) / var(--space-16); express desktop 112px with tokens or name it as an allowed raw value.

findings.title: site.mjs sizes carry screen and touch, but newContext cannot set them
findings.where: design.md Test plan site.mjs sizes; test/e2e/lib.mjs newContext
findings.fix: Size passes build contexts like responsive.mjs (viewport, screen, deviceScaleFactor 2, hasTouch, isMobile on Chromium touch sizes, reducedMotion, serviceWorkers) with the theme init script; other runs use newContext.
